name: Kuroshio Extension
scope: NOAA glossary Kuroshio Extension extent from approximately 145 to 160 degrees E, upstream of its separately named North Pacific Current. This naming convention is not a universal termination rule for all Kuroshio Extension literature; excludes the coastal Kuroshio, recirculation gyres and downstream North Pacific extent.
layer: Upper-ocean regional flow geography; no diagnosed depth-specific jet axis.
time_convention: Undated editorial route under NOAA glossary naming limits; not a synoptic jet or time-averaged observed axis.
source_locator: Kuroshio Extension entry: eastward continuation between approximate 145 and 160 degrees E. North Pacific Current entry names the next component separately.
source_citation: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services, Tides and Currents Glossary, Kuroshio Extension entry (accessed 2026-10-02).
source_license: Factual geography only; no source curves, map imagery or velocity field packaged.
coordinate_selection: NOAA supplies approximate longitudes and eastward identity; OSW selects latitudes and intermediate vertices. These routes are broad editorial corridors, not diagnosed meandering axes or source-reported latitude limits.
